page_title: LAZ 1-0 ACM | Lazio v AC Milan 15/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Maurizio Sarri, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!

90+7' Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Edoardo Motta is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
90+5' Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post.
90+5' Patric (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' Pedro (Lazio) picks up a yellow card.
90+4' It looks like Koni De Winter (AC Milan) saw red with that tackle. Marco Guida won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.
90+3' Luka Modric (AC Milan) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
90+2' A cross into the box from Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) is cleared.
90+1' AC Milan take a short corner kick.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Maurizio Sarri is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) suffers an injury and Reda Belahyane comes on.
88' The current number of corner kicks is 1:7.

87' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marco Guida blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
86' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lazio was in an offside position.
85' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) tries to find Boulaye Dia, but he puts too much power on the pass.
84' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers will be replaced by Samuele Ricci (AC Milan).
84' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Nuno Tavares (Lazio).
83' The game has come to an end for Mattia Zaccagni. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio).

82' That's unlucky! Luka Modric (AC Milan) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
82' AC Milan are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
81' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Nuno Tavares (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
80' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
80' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. AC Milan force a corner. They send men into the box.
79' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
79' The ball is cleared after Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. AC Milan get a corner.
79' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AC Milan.
78' A quickly taken corner by AC Milan.
77' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
77' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
77' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
75' The Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Marco Guida rules it out for a handball.
75' AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
73' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
73' Referee Marco Guida signals NO PENALTY for AC Milan after a VAR review!

72' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for AC Milan.
71' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
70' Edoardo Motta (Lazio) is booked.
70' Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) is caught offside!
67' It is time for a substitution. Pedro (Lazio) is on for Gustav Isaksen.
67' The referee signals a substitution. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is brought on as a substitute for Daniel Maldini.
66' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) replacing Youssouf Fofana.
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) is replacing Rafael Leao.

66' Luka Modric (AC Milan) controls the ball and sets off to face the goalkeeper, but deep inside the box the ball bounces up on the uneven surface and makes him miss the strike, sending the ball well over the goal.
65' Good defending. Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) tries to find Youssouf Fofana inside the box, but the pass is cut out.

62' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
62' 6:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
60' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
58' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Fikayo Tomori and he is replaced by Zachary Athekame (AC Milan).
57' That's the end of the game for Pervis Estupinan, who is replaced by Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan).
55' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Marco Guida didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
52' A header by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) from very close range goes towards the left-hand post, but doesn't get past Edoardo Motta, who makes a brilliant save.

52' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Edoardo Motta is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
51' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
50' The game is interrupted as Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is flagged offside.
48' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
46' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Marco Guida blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' A corner kick by Lazio is thwarted by the well prepared Mike Maignan (AC Milan).

43' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
42' AC Milan are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
40' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:0.
39' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marco Guida saw the whole situation.
38' That's a well played offside trap. Daniel Maldini (Lazio) is flagged for offside, ending the attack.
37' Some great play by Daniel Maldini (Lazio) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Mike Maignan sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
36' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
35' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
31' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
30' A lofted cross from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
30' Lazio have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
29' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Guida interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

26' 1 - 0 Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Mike Maignan is just a bystander as the ball flies into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
25' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar.

23' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
22' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
21' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
20' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 45:55.
18' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Guida blows for a foul.

16' A through ball from Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) fails to reach Daniel Maldini as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Daniel Maldini could have got into a promising position.
14' Luka Modric (AC Milan) produces a cunning chipped pass for Christian Pulisic, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
13' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
11' Marco Guida blows his whistle and it's Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
11' AC Milan quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

10' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. AC Milan will take a corner kick.
9' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) passes the ball onto Gustav Isaksen, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
6' Neat passing move from AC Milan in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
1' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Lazio will take the kick-off.
Marco Guida is introduced as the referee for today's match.
